authorship: Local conservative interpretation; not provider code or runtime observation

rules.evidence: The prompt text. Exactly one non-empty text item is required per request.
The prompt text. Exactly one non-empty text item is required per request.
rules.interpretation: Require a string with non-whitespace content; trimming is a local blankness test only, never a prompt rewrite.
Block shared-schema video/audio items for this text/image-only model; output audio is not input-audio support.
Unknown media kinds are blocked, not presumed supported.

rules.evidence: Role of a media item. Options: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio, base_video. Keyframe roles and reference_* roles are mutually exclusive within a request; base_video marks the source video of a video regeneration request.
rules.interpretation: This lane maps only exact first_frame, last_frame, reference_image image roles. Domain character/style/etc and sibling-video roles are not silently converted.

rules.evidence: Role of a media item. Options: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio, base_video. Keyframe roles and reference_* roles are mutually exclusive within a request; base_video marks the source video of a video regeneration request.
rules.interpretation: Block any keyframe plus reference_image mixture.

rules.evidence: Role of a media item. Options: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio, base_video. Keyframe roles and reference_* roles are mutually exclusive within a request; base_video marks the source video of a video regeneration request.
rules.interpretation: One binding per first/last slot is a local intent invariant, not an observed provider count limit.

evidence.description: Content items driving the generation. Must contain one non-empty text item; optionally add first_frame/last_frame images or reference_* media.

rules.interpretation: No maxItems or per-role numeric maximum is published. This experiment covers one reference only; more is blocked pending evidence, not advertised as a provider max=1.

rules.evidence: Image source. Required for image_url items.
rules.interpretation: Require a non-blank source locator. No network reachability, data-URI decoding, file ownership, pixel/byte limits or transport safety is established.

rules.evidence: Aspect ratio. Options: adaptive (default), 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Required and must not be adaptive for text-to-video; ignored (treated as adaptive) for first-frame or last-frame generation.
rules.interpretation: Allow only listed values. Even when frames ignore ratio, an unlisted spelling is blocked conservatively rather than assumed accepted.

rules.evidence: Aspect ratio. Options: adaptive (default), 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Required and must not be adaptive for text-to-video; ignored (treated as adaptive) for first-frame or last-frame generation.
rules.interpretation: Neither frames nor references means text-to-video: explicit non-adaptive ratio required. First/last frames make ratio frame-determined; preserve any explicit requested value unchanged.

rules.evidence: Aspect ratio. Options: adaptive (default), 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Required and must not be adaptive for text-to-video; ignored (treated as adaptive) for first-frame or last-frame generation.
rules.interpretation: Reference-only effective geometry is not described as frame-conditioned. Allow a listed explicit non-adaptive ratio as a candidate; block omitted/adaptive instead of inventing geometry behavior.

rules.evidence: Random seed in [-1, 2^32 - 1]; omitted or -1 is random.
rules.interpretation: Check -1 through 2^32-1. Retain -1, zero and omission distinctly; do not claim deterministic reruns.

aigc_watermark.description: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the output. Defaults to false.

callback_url.description: Optional. URL to receive task state changes after challenge verification.

content.description: Content items driving the generation. Must contain one non-empty text item; optionally add first_frame/last_frame images or reference_* media.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Comfy Router accepts 4 to 15 and refuses anything outside it before the provider is called. MiniMax's own documentation for this model states 5 to 15; the ComfyUI MiniMax H3 nodes offer 4 to 15 and a 4-second generation has been observed to succeed, so 4 is accepted here.

model.description: ID of model. Options: MiniMax-H3. Router callers may omit this field or send null; Router injects the model selected by the request path before provider dispatch.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Options: adaptive (default), 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Required and must not be adaptive for text-to-video; ignored (treated as adaptive) for first-frame or last-frame generation.

resolution.description: Video resolution. Options: 2K, 768P. The value is matched case-insensitively and canonicalised before dispatch, so `2k` and `768p` are accepted and sent as `2K` and `768P`.

seed.description: Random seed in [-1, 2^32 - 1]; omitted or -1 is random.

rules.interpretation: Strict bounded lane refuses extras at top/item/image-source levels. model and callback_url exist publicly but are deliberately not emitted; no invented audio switch, overrides or arbitrary callback destinations.

evidence.description: Video length in seconds. Comfy Router accepts 4 to 15 and refuses anything outside it before the provider is called. MiniMax's own documentation for this model states 5 to 15; the ComfyUI MiniMax H3 nodes offer 4 to 15 and a 4-second generation has been observed to succeed, so 4 is accepted here.

rules.interpretation: Use actual integer minimum/maximum, not a guessed prose-only minimum. 4 is structurally admitted by this snapshot; the source-reported success is NOT our observed success. Proposed live shot uses 5.

evidence.description: Video resolution. Options: 2K, 768P. The value is matched case-insensitively and canonicalised before dispatch, so `2k` and `768p` are accepted and sent as `2K` and `768P`.

rules.interpretation: Use exact enum spellings. Keep submitted spelling; report documented uppercase canonicalization separately, never as measured output.
